services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: This isn’t your average summer camp. Against the backdrop of real dinosaur fossils, chemistry in action and a world-class institution, kids can experience a summer of education and adventure. Geared for kids ages 6-12, Summer Camps at HMNS use fun, hands-on learning and distinguished teachers to inspire the next generation of engineers and scientists. A wide range of topics from physics and coding to paleontology and forensic science are explored. Interactive Learning - Week-long, hands-on camps featuring science activities for children ages 6 - 12. The Summer Camp courses provided by the Houston Museum of Natural Science (HMNS) are considered Single-Skill Programs and Short-Term Programs
